patch_description:
Replace the current-state greedy choice with a projected minimax choice: each candidate GPU is evaluated using its KVPR after the model is added, together with the maximum KVPR of every other GPU. This directly matches the objective rather than selecting the GPU with the lowest pre-placement pressure.

The edit also tries several inexpensive deterministic model orderings. Model placement is a constrained bin-packing problem, so a single ordering can create memory fragmentation or a poor local balance. Selecting the best feasible result among pressure-first, size-first, pressure-density-first, and combined-demand-first orderings improves solution quality while retaining simple, bounded greedy execution.
